nodes.summary: Let $U$ be a bounded, open and connected subset of a finite-dimensional real inner product space, and let $u$ be harmonic on $U$ and continuous on $\overline U$. If $u$ attains its maximum over $\overline U$ at a point of $U$, then $u$ is constant on $\overline U$.
nodes.title: Strong maximum principle for harmonic functions

nodes.summary: Let $U$ be a bounded open subset of a nontrivial finite-dimensional real inner product space and let $f : U \to \mathbb{R}$ be any function. If $u_1, u_2 \in C^2(U) \cap C(\overline U)$ both solve
nodes.title: Uniqueness for the Dirichlet problem for Poisson's equation

nodes.summary: Let $U \subseteq \mathbb{C}$ be open and connected and let $u : \mathbb{C} \to \mathbb{R}$ be harmonic on $U$. If $u$ attains its maximum over $U$ at a point $x_0 \in U$, then $u = u(x_0)$ on all of $U$. No boundedness of $U$ is needed.
nodes.title: Strong maximum principle for planar harmonic functions

nodes.summary: Let $U \subseteq \mathbb{C}$ be open and let $u : \mathbb{C} \to \mathbb{R}$ be harmonic on $U$. If $u$ attains its maximum over $U$ at $z \in U$, then $u$ is constant on some disc around $z$ contained in $U$.
nodes.title: A planar harmonic function is constant near an interior maximum

nodes.summary: Let $U$ be a nonempty bounded open subset of a nontrivial finite-dimensional real inner product space, and let $u$ be harmonic on $U$ (Mathlib's `InnerProductSpace.HarmonicOnNhd`) and continuous on $\overline U$. Then $u$ attains its maximum over $\overline U$ at a point of $\partial U$.
nodes.title: Weak maximum principle for harmonic functions

nodes.summary: Let $U$ be a nonempty bounded open subset of a nontrivial finite-dimensional real inner product space, for instance of $\mathbb{R}^n$ with $n \ge 1$. nodes.title: Weak maximum principle for subharmonic functions

nodes.summary: Under the hypotheses of the weak maximum principle, a harmonic function $u$ also attains its minimum over $\overline U$ at a point of $\partial U$: $\min_{\overline U} u = \min_{\partial U} u$.
nodes.title: Weak minimum principle for harmonic functions

nodes.title: Mean-value property of harmonic functions, and its converse

nodes.summary: Let $U$ be an open subset of a finite-dimensional real inner product space and let $V$ be open and connected with $\overline V$ compact and contained in $U$. There is a constant $C > 0$, depending only on $V$ and $U$, such that every nonnegative harmonic function $u$ on $U$ satisfies
nodes.title: Harnack's inequality for harmonic functions

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a real inner product space and let $f : E \to \mathbb{R}$ be $C^2$ at $z$. For every direction $e \in E$, the second derivative of $f$ at $z$ evaluated at $(e, e)$ is the second derivative at $0$ of the restriction of $f$ to the line through $z$ in the direction $e$:
nodes.title: Second derivative along a line

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a real inner product space and let $f : E \to \mathbb{R}$ be $C^2$ at a local maximum $z$. Then $D^2 f(z)(e, e) \le 0$ for every direction $e$: the second derivative of $f$ at $z$ is negative semidefinite.
nodes.title: Nonpositive second derivatives at a local maximum

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a finite-dimensional real inner product space and let $f : E \to \mathbb{R}$ be $C^2$ at a local maximum $z$. Then $\Delta f(z) \le 0$, where $\Delta$ is Mathlib's Laplacian (`InnerProductSpace.laplacian`), the trace of the second derivative.
nodes.title: The Laplacian is nonpositive at an interior maximum

nodes.summary: Let $E$ be a real inner product space of finite dimension $n$. Then $\Delta \|x\|^2 = 2n$ at every point. In $\mathbb{R}^n$ this is $\Delta |x|^2 = \sum_i \partial_i^2 (x_1^2 + \dots + x_n^2) = 2n$.
nodes.title: Laplacian of the squared norm

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
